title: Oklab gradient path: linear_to_srgb and srgb_to_linear have their exponents swapped
expected_finding: srgb_to_oklab feeds the sRGB-encoded stop colours (hsla_to_rgba of the [Color("srgb")] stops) through srgb_to_linear, which raises to 1/2.2 (an encode), so the Oklab matrices receive sRGB-encoded rather than linear values; oklab_to_srgb's linear_to_srgb then raises to 2.2 (a decode) before the value is written to the UNORM target that expects sRGB-encoded values
